Define Omega_L(q)=min(1,inf_N[4/N+4A_N sqrt(Psi_LN(q))]), where LN includes the finitely many grid-cap energy bounds. Grid oscillation and both maxima zero give int|a-b|theta^2<=Omega_L(I). Smooth sqrt(f^2+epsilon^2) ramps, with derivative bounded1 and Green paired with DD(cT), give

For normalized a, c=-Ea, q0=Q_theta(a),q1=Q_theta_a(a), integrating E'' twice gives c=A+2q0/3+q1/3 and -E(za)=zA+z^2(1-z/3)q0+z^3q1/3<=z+1.5z^2c.
